fr.title: Grande maraude de Noël
fr.address: Point de rendez-vous communiqué aux bénévoles inscrits
fr.image_alt: Des mains tendent des paniers de pain frais
fr.summary: Repas chauds, manteaux et cadeaux remis aux personnes sans abri du centre-ville.
fr.body:
La maraude la plus importante de l’année. Les repas et les manteaux offerts par la campagne de Noël seront remis ce soir-là.

Les bénévoles reçoivent une courte formation avant le départ. Inscription obligatoire.

en.title: Christmas street outreach
en.address: Meeting point shared with registered volunteers
en.image_alt: Hands holding out baskets of fresh bread
en.summary: Hot meals, coats and gifts handed to people sleeping rough downtown.
en.body:
The biggest outreach night of the year. The meals and coats given through the Christmas campaign are handed over that night.

Volunteers get a short briefing before heading out. Registration required.
